name: principle-attack-the-premise
description: "Apply when two or more fixes that share one premise have failed the same gate. Write the premise down and test it directly before you write another fix that assumes it."
disable-model-invocation: true
---
blocks.zh:
---
name: principle-attack-the-premise
description: "两个以上基于同一前提的修复未通过同一门禁时应用。再写依赖该前提的新修复前，先写下前提并直接验证。"
disable-model-invocation: true
---

blocks.en: When two or more fixes that share one premise have failed the same gate, suspect the premise, not the fixes.
blocks.zh: 当两个或更多共享同一前提的修复在同一个关卡失败时，应怀疑前提，而不是修复。

blocks.en: **Why:** Each failed fix is evidence against the belief it assumed. A third fix on the same premise spends effort where the evidence already says the cause is not.
blocks.zh: **原因：** 每次修复失败都是反对其前提的证据。第三次继续沿用相同前提，会把精力花在证据已表明不是原因的地方。

blocks.en:
**Pattern:**
- **Write the premise down.** The premise is the one sentence that every failed fix assumed.
- **Test the premise before the next fix.** Find an observation that would come out differently if the premise were false, and make it. Look at how the failures are distributed, not only at how large they are. Make the check rerunnable per [Build the Lever](../principle-build-the-lever/SKILL.md).
- **Follow the evidence.** If it contradicts the premise, the cause is elsewhere. Look for what the failures have in common that the premise did not predict. If it confirms the premise, ask the next "why" per [Fix Root Causes](../principle-fix-root-causes/SKILL.md). The earlier fixes may have treated a consequence instead of the cause.
- **Remove the condition instead of compensating for it**, per the [Laziness Protocol](../principle-laziness-protocol/SKILL.md). If the evidence shows that one part always lands on the losing side, change what puts it there. A mechanism that cleans up after it leaves the cause in place and adds work on every run.
blocks.zh:
**做法：**
- **写下前提。** 用一句话说明每次失败修复都依赖的假定。
- **新修复前先验证前提。** 找出当前提错误时会不同的观察结果，并实际观察。除了失败规模，也看分布。按 [Build the Lever](../principle-build-the-lever/SKILL.md) 让检查可重跑。
- **跟随证据。** 证据反对前提就到别处寻找原因，检查失败有哪些前提未预测的共同点。证据支持前提就按 [Fix Root Causes](../principle-fix-root-causes/SKILL.md) 继续问“为什么”，此前可能只处理了后果。
- **消除条件，而不是补偿它。** 按 [Laziness Protocol](../principle-laziness-protocol/SKILL.md)，若某部分总是处于不利状态，改变导致它陷入该状态的机制。事后清理保留根因，并增加每次运行的工作。

blocks.en: **Stop:** Do not start the next fix before the premise is written down and tested.
blocks.zh: **停止条件：** 写下并验证前提之前，不开始下一次修复。

blocks.en: This principle is distinct from [Redesign from First Principles](../principle-redesign-from-first-principles/SKILL.md), which rebuilds a design around a new requirement. It questions a fact the current design assumes.
blocks.zh: 这一原则不同于[从第一性原理重新设计](../principle-redesign-from-first-principles/SKILL.md)：后者围绕新需求重建设计，而本原则质疑当前设计所假定的事实。
